reason: E-Golf4U is going away, so I have to pick the system we'll run 950 members and 1.8 million in turnover on for the next five years, and right now that's not going to be two founders whose first club isn't even live yet. A free pilot is nice, but it doesn't help much when our current system won't keep running for long anyway, and I can't take a board decision on a reference I can't call yet.
objection: Two founders and no live club. If one of them drops out or they fold, I'm the one who has to explain to 950 members, many of them over seventy, why we're switching systems again in two years. Twelve months' notice and a spreadsheet export don't fix that. And I don't see anything about the federation link for handicaps and competition results, which is non-negotiable for us.
would_change_my_mind: Golfclub Zwolle live for a full season, with their board telling me on the phone that their older members actually use it, plus written confirmation of the link to the federation's handicap system.
